description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Basilica Shepherd.
Basilica Shepherd enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Emiel triggers twice; choose not to pay both times.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
